subject: Two Approaches
source_sentence: We present two approaches to generating Arabic sentiment lexicons from a large dataset of 2.2 million tweets.
title: AraSenTi: Large-Scale Twitter-Specific Arabic Sentiment Lexicons

subject: Lexicons
source_sentence: The lexicons are evaluated on three datasets, one internal dataset extracted from the larger dataset of tweets and two external datasets from the literature on Arabic SA.
title: AraSenTi: Large-Scale Twitter-Specific Arabic Sentiment Lexicons

subject: Lexicons
source_sentence: Moreo- ver, the lexicons are compared to an external Arabic lexicon generated also from tweets.
title: AraSenTi: Large-Scale Twitter-Specific Arabic Sentiment Lexicons

subject: Search Engine
source_sentence: Turney, (2002); Turney and Littman, (2002) used the once popular AltaVista search engine to find the sentiment of a certain word through calculating the association strength be- tween the word and a set of positive words minus the association strength between the word and a set of negative words.
title: AraSenTi: Large-Scale Twitter-Specific Arabic Sentiment Lexicons

subject: plan
source_sentence: We also plan to make the classification multi-way: positive , negative, neu- tral and mixed.
title: AraSenTi: Large-Scale Twitter-Specific Arabic Sentiment Lexicons
